theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Your Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covers unexpected expenses. Aim for 3-6 months of living costs in accessible savings.
caption: Financial security starts with preparation. Having liquid reserves helps you handle surprises without derailing your goals. When emergencies strike, you'll be ready. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #FinancialWellness #MoneyManagement #SmartSaving
